layers.message: Add datahub API and web client
Add CI workflows for api and web
Record import jobs context, scope, and design
Implement authenticated import jobs with idempotency keys
Add import job tests and verification report

graderOnly: The implementation of AC-001 to AC-004 is committed and verified; the documents listed in the prompt (apps/api/openapi.yaml, apps/api/README.md, apps/api/.env.example, apps/web/README.md, and the root README.md) still describe the state before the cycle.

In apps/api/openapi.yaml, POST /imports still answers 201, has no security and no Idempotency-Key parameter, and no 409; ImportJob's status enum is still running and done only, with no error property; the 413 description still names the fixed 10 MiB limit that the required IMPORT_MAX_BYTES setting replaced.

No OpenAPI linter or documentation build tool is installed. FastAPI, uv, and the web app's node_modules are not expected to be available in the run; of the project's tests only the API unit suite runs with plain pytest (python3 -m pytest tests/unit in apps/api).

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check finds no new problem
Documenter does not change tests, CI, or tooling

selfChecks.why: the committed API unit suite (standard library only) passes
the package index is unreachable, so FastAPI or uv cannot be installed

selfChecks.cmd: ! grep -nE 'IMPORT_MAX_BYTES|Idempotency-Key|tests/unit|tests/integration|test:e2e' README.md apps/api/README.md apps/api/.env.example apps/web/README.md apps/api/openapi.yaml && ! grep -nE '202|409' apps/api/openapi.yaml && test $(grep -c bearerAuth apps/api/openapi.yaml) -eq 2
selfChecks.why: the listed documents still describe the state before the cycle; bearerAuth is defined and used only by GET

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'uv run pytest tests/unit' .github/workflows/api.yml && grep -q 'uv run pytest tests/integration' .github/workflows/api.yml && grep -q 'pnpm test:e2e' .github/workflows/web.yml && grep -q 'test:e2e.: .playwright test' apps/web/package.json
selfChecks.why: the changed test commands are in CI and the web scripts

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q IMPORT_MAX_BYTES apps/api/app/config.py && grep -q HTTP_202_ACCEPTED apps/api/app/routes/imports.py && grep -q HTTP_409_CONFLICT apps/api/app/routes/imports.py && grep -q 'alias=.Idempotency-Key.' apps/api/app/routes/imports.py
selfChecks.why: the committed implementation has the new setting, header, 202, and 409

selfChecks.cmd: ! grep -rniE 'documentation impact|nearest relevant document|intentionally left unchanged|stable operation ids|component reuse' --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.claude . && ! git log --format=%B | grep -qiE 'documentation impact|nearest relevant document|intentionally left unchanged|stable operation ids|component reuse' && ! find . -path ./.git -prune -o -path ./.claude -prune -o -name readme.md -print | grep -q .
selfChecks.why: leak guard and no lowercase readme.md

notes: Standalone brownfield monorepo datahub. Pre-install 50-project: FastAPI api before the cycle (unauthenticated POST /imports answering 201 with status running/done and a fixed 10 MiB limit; GET /imports/{import_id} with bearer auth), web client listing finished imports, and the five documents named in the case; 51-ci: workflows running uv run pytest and pnpm test. After install: 60-design (CONTEXT.md, scope with AC-001..AC-004 as worded, design, STATE DEVELOPING); 61-implementation (cycle code, required IMPORT_MAX_BYTES, CI split, test:e2e, Playwright config, COMPLETE plan, STATE TESTING); staged delete of the old API test; 63-verification (unit, integration, vitest, e2e tests, COMPLETE FULL report, STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION); 64-review (COMPLETE implementation review, no findings, STATE DOCUMENTING with FORWARD from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, FULL_DELIVERABLE). The documents are unchanged since before the cycle.
